selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed module could be inserted via modprobe; after adding blacklist+install /bin/false directive, modprobe dry-run showed 'install /bin/false' and an actual modprobe attempt failed with 'Operation not permitted', module remained absent from lsmod.

selected_evidence.requirement: usb_storage blocked from loading after reboot (persistence)
selected_evidence.summary: update-initramfs -u -k all regenerated the boot image; lsinitramfs confirmed the blacklist-usb-storage.conf file is embedded inside the initramfs that will be used at next boot.
Captured pre-restart boot_id (2dffe735-...) and btime (1788580175) plus confirmed blacklist config present and baked into initramfs.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'reboot' command returned 'reboot_acknowledged' with exit_code 0 before the node went down.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: First poll after reboot got 'Connection refused' proving the node was down; subsequent poll returned a new boot_id (c2ff926e-...) and new btime (1788580228), differing from the pre-restart values, proving a genuine reboot occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required state (module blacklist)
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, usb_storage remained absent from lsmod, the blacklist conf file was still present, and a modprobe load attempt still failed with 'Operation not permitted', confirming the block survived the restart.
